sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ॥ ८-३॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo’dhyātmamucyate
bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ 8-3
translation: The Blessed Lord said: 3 . BRAHMAN is Imperishable, the Supreme; His essential nature is called Self-knowledge, the creative force that causes beings to spring forth into manifestation is called work.
